The commented-out GPG verification section indicates an intent to verify signatures if the public key becomes available, which reflects good security hygiene rather than malicious intent. The build process is transparent and focused solely on delivering a verified ISO image for use with libvirt, consistent with the package's stated purpose.
</details>
